cards.text: Jesus is teaching in a synagogue on the Sabbath, and He's just set free a woman who'd been bent over for eighteen years (Luke 13:10-13). The whole crowd is rejoicing at all the glorious things He's doing (Luke 13:17). Then He asks what the kingdom of God is like, and what He can compare it to, and friend, I'm leaning in so far my hat's about to fall off.
First picture: a man tosses a seed into his garden. Just tosses it, friend, which is my whole method with sprinkles, and some of them even hit the cookie.

cards.question: Jesus' first picture of the kingdom of God is a seed a man tosses into his garden. Which seed is it?
True or false: The mustard seed the man tosses into his garden grows and becomes a tree.
The mustard seed has become a tree. What nests in its branches?

cards.text: Jesus doesn't stop to explain the tree, and He asks again, “To what can I compare the kingdom of God?” This time His picture comes straight out of the kitchen, and friend, I am SITTING UP.

cards.question: In Jesus' second picture, the kingdom of God is like ___.

cards.text: A woman takes the leaven and mixes it into three measures of flour. Friend, flour and something mixed in is my whole life.

cards.question: A woman mixes leaven into three measures of flour, until ___ of it is leavened.
